violation.coverage: Understaffed: the shift on {date} needs {required} ({qualification}), {assigned} assigned.
violation.min_rest: {required}-hour rest period not met: only {hours} hours before the shift on {date}.
violation.max_consecutive_nights: {nights} night shifts in a row, at most {max} allowed.
violation.max_weekends: Duty on {weekends} weekends this month, at most {max} allowed.
violation.max_on_call: {count} on-call duties this month, at most {max} allowed.
violation.max_on_call_home: {count} on-call-from-home duties this month, at most {max} allowed.
violation.free_day_after_on_call: Duty on {date}, although a free day follows an on-call duty.
violation.contract_hours_band: {percent}% of contract hours planned, {low} to {high}% allowed.
violation.qualification: The shift on {date} needs the qualification “{qualification}”.
violation.role: This shift type is not planned for this role ({date}).
violation.unavailable: Duty on {date}, although {reason, select, leave {leave is approved} other {“can't” was entered}}.
violation.not_rostered: Duty on {date}, although the person is not on the department's roster that day.

fix.coverage: Assign a suitable person to the shift on {date}.
fix.one_shift_per_day: Give one of the shifts on {date} to someone else.
fix.min_rest: Swap the shift on {date} or move the shift before it, so {required} hours of rest remain.
fix.max_consecutive_nights: Give the night shift on {date} to someone else (at most {max} in a row).
fix.max_weekends: Give one weekend to someone else (at most {max}).
fix.max_on_call: Give one on-call duty to someone else (at most {max}).
fix.max_on_call_home: Give one on-call-from-home duty to someone else (at most {max}).
fix.free_day_after_on_call: Give the shift on {date} to someone else.
fix.contract_hours_band: Spread the shifts so the hours stay between {low} and {high}%.
fix.role: Assign someone whose role includes this shift type.
fix.unavailable: Give the shift on {date} to someone else.
fix.not_rostered: Give the shift on {date} to someone on the roster.

infeasible.coverage: Not coverable: {date} needs {required} for the shift ({qualification}), only {available} available after approved leave.
infeasible.person: For one person, the rule “{rule}” cannot be kept this month.
infeasible.unknown: No valid roster found; the cause could not be narrowed down.

escalation.rule_violation: The validator found a rule violation; the planner decides.
escalation.hours_band: Without this shift, the hours of the person giving it away would fall below the band; the planner decides.
escalation.overtime: Taking the shift means overtime; the planner decides.
escalation.policy_off: Automatic approval is switched off; the planner decides.
escalation.list_exhausted: Nobody on the list took the shift; the planner decides.
escalation.validator_unavailable: Received before the validator existed; the planner decides.

approval.policy: Approved automatically (planner's policy, checked by the validator)

recommendation.balanced: Recommended: the balanced profile, with weights tuned on July to December 2024.

m5.tradeOff: Coverable if you take one extra weekend in {month}
m5.notCoverable: Not coverable without breaking a rule.
m5.notApplicable: No trade is checked for these dates.

reason.month_published: The month is already published; the planner arranges cover.
reason.previous_month_planned: The month before is already planned; a trade is no longer possible there.
reason.previous_month_unsolved: No valid roster was found for the month before.
reason.weekend_limit: An extra weekend in the month before would exceed the maximum.
reason.trade_off_infeasible: With the extra weekend, there is no valid roster for the month before.
reason.trade_off_invalid: The roster with the trade did not pass the validator.
reason.baseline_unsolved: The month could not be compared without this leave.

m6.audience: Offer goes to {n} colleagues who can exchange with you
m6.giveawayBelowHours: You can't give this shift away alone: you'd fall below your contract hours. Offer an exchange instead.
